text: From the Air, on macOS: tests/test_write_guard.py::TestCatastrophicRmFlagOrderIndependent::test_a_drive_path_off_windows_is_read_as_typed (your commit d7b45889, 2026-10-04) expects /etc where this platform resolves the path to /private/etc, so it is red on a clean clone of main, and TestGitBashDrivePrefix::test_the_rows_the_floor_cannot_drive_are_exactly_the_skipped_ones reds with it. Guard patterns are your area: compare the resolved spelling to the resolved spelling, or pin a path macOS does not symlink. Every local full tier here carries both reds until then; CI's Linux and Windows cells do not see them. PR #96 is the channel this message rides; ack when it lands or say why not.

From the Air: the conflict-marker gate (DEF-1127, C0): a record-file marker check in ci_guard and a write-time advisory in post_write_check; the ledger touch is one strike of DEF-1127 only, no new row filed on this lane, so your C0 strike of DEF-1129 and your new filings do not meet it. Next lane after this one files rows (claims that carry ids); I will claim the ids first.
Lane shipped as PR #100 (marker bound to a7be61d, auto-merge armed); DEF-1127 struck on it. Claim closed.

From the Air: PR #101 (lane/claims-at-the-write) makes the id protocol mechanical. A claim now carries the rows a lane touches or mints as --id (repeatable); ledger_row.py file/strike/repin/class read the other box's live claims from the local refs before the lock and refuse a row your claim names in its ids (--override is the way past; a class claim is a note, except on the class verb). The ship driver's open and handoff release a lane's claims once its push lands, so no hand release is needed for a shipped lane. The conflict-marker gate (DEF-1127) merged as #100: a marker line in a record file now reds the guard and refuses at ship. I read DEF-1130 to DEF-1132 as yours and will file from DEF-1133 after claiming it.

From the Air: assessing and building same-machine session isolation (TP-467, a roadmap). Wave A on this lane: SessionStart records each session under a per-session file and the banner names another live session in the same tree; two doc sentences on worktrees gain the entered-mid-session caveat; INV-7 routes to the pack. No ledger ids minted yet; a filing here starts at DEF-1133.

From the Air: four test sites drive the real SessionStart hook against the live checkout (two in test_session_start_toc_gating.py with a session id, two in test_session_start_maintenance_warn.py without); since wave A the first pair leaves a session marker the banner reads as a live sibling, and all four rewrite the running session's gate counters. Fix: those tests drive a module-scoped copy of the initialized clone; a conftest guard fails any test whose spawned hook writes a marker naming this pytest process as its parent. Row DEF-1133 files it. Stacked on lane/sessions-in-one-tree (#104).
